Now I have a thorough understanding of the entire system. Let me compile the complete analysis.

---

## 1. Architecture Overview

The `Discoverer` interface lives in `discovery/discovery.go` in the **prometheus** repo. It is the single contract that every service discovery (SD) mechanism must satisfy. Currently it has exactly **one method**:

```go
type Discoverer interface {
    Run(ctx context.Context, up chan<- []*targetgroup.Group)
}
```

Adding `HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error` to this interface is a **breaking change** that propagates across every layer of every repo that touches this interface:

```
discovery/discovery.go  ← interface definition (change here)
        │
        ├── Every SD implementation (Run method structs) ← must add HealthCheck()
        │     discovery/consul, kubernetes, file, dns, aws/*, azure, gce, ...
        │     discovery/refresh.Discovery (shared base used by ~20 providers)
        │     documentation/examples/custom-sd/adapter-usage/main.go
        │     clients/pkg/promtail/discovery/consulagent/consul.go (Loki)
        │
        ├── discovery/manager.go ← calls p.d.Run(); may need to call HealthCheck()
        ├── documentation/examples/custom-sd/adapter/adapter.go ← holds disc discovery.Discoverer
        ├── cmd/promtool/sd.go ← calls d.Run() directly
        │
        └── External consumers (Thanos, OTel Operator)
              cmd/thanos/endpointset.go ← calls fileSD.Run() directly
              cmd/otel-allocator/internal/target/discovery.go ← wraps discovery.Manager
```

---

## 2. Detailed Analysis

### 2.1 The Interface — `discovery/discovery.go` (prometheus)

**File:** `discovery/discovery.go`, lines 35–40

```go
type Discoverer interface {
    Run(ctx context.Context, up chan<- []*targetgroup.Group)
}
```

**Change required:**
```go
type Discoverer interface {
    Run(ctx context.Context, up chan<- []*targetgroup.Group)
    HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error
}
```

This is the epicentre. Every struct that currently satisfies `Discoverer` by only implementing `Run` will now fail to compile.

---

### 2.2 `staticDiscoverer` — `discovery/discovery.go` (prometheus)

**File:** `discovery/discovery.go`, lines 159–168

The `staticDiscoverer` type (a `[]*targetgroup.Group` alias) implements `Discoverer` via its `Run` method. It is returned by `StaticConfig.NewDiscoverer`. It must gain a `HealthCheck` method — for a static list, this is always healthy:

```go
func (c staticDiscoverer) HealthCheck(_ context.Context) error { return nil }
```

---

### 2.3 `refresh.Discovery` — `discovery/refresh/refresh.go` (prometheus)

**File:** `discovery/refresh/refresh.go`, lines 37–119

`Discovery` is the **shared base** used by approximately 20 SD providers (AWS EC2/ECS/Lightsail/MSK, Azure, DigitalOcean, DNS, Eureka, GCE, Hetzner, HTTP, IONOS, Linode, Marathon, Moby/Docker/Swarm, Nomad, OpenStack, OVHcloud, PuppetDB, Scaleway, STACKIT, Triton, Uyuni, Vultr). All of these delegate their `Run` to `refresh.Discovery.Run`. Since `refresh.Discovery` is the concrete type returned by `NewDiscovery` and stored as a `Discoverer`, it must implement `HealthCheck`. A sensible default: attempt one `refreshf` call and return the error.

```go
func (d *Discovery) HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error {
    _, err := d.refresh(ctx)
    return err
}
```

This single addition covers all ~20 refresh-based providers.

---

### 2.4 SD Providers with Custom `Run` (not using `refresh.Discovery`)

These providers implement `Run` directly and must each add `HealthCheck`:

| Provider | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Consul** | `discovery/consul/consul.go` | `Discovery` struct, `Run` at ~L326. HealthCheck: ping Consul `/v1/status/leader` |
| **Kubernetes** | `discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go` | `Discovery` struct, `Run` at ~L347. HealthCheck: check k8s API server reachability |
| **File SD** | `discovery/file/file.go` | `Discovery` struct, `Run` at ~L238. HealthCheck: verify watched files are readable |
| **Zookeeper** | `discovery/zookeeper/zookeeper.go` | `Discovery` struct, `Run` at ~L199. HealthCheck: ping ZK ensemble |
| **xDS** | `discovery/xds/xds.go` | `fetchDiscovery` struct, `Run` at ~L110. HealthCheck: attempt one poll |

---

### 2.5 `discovery/manager.go` — Provider Lifecycle (prometheus)

**File:** `discovery/manager.go`, lines 309–335

The manager calls `p.d.Run(ctx, updates)` at line 333. It holds `Discoverer` in the `Provider.d` field (line 53: `d Discoverer`). The manager itself does not call `HealthCheck`, but it **could** be extended to periodically call `p.d.HealthCheck(ctx)` and expose health status per provider. At minimum, the `StartCustomProvider` method at line 310 accepts a `Discoverer` — any custom provider passed here must now implement `HealthCheck`.

---

### 2.6 `documentation/examples/custom-sd/adapter/adapter.go` (prometheus)

**File:** `documentation/examples/custom-sd/adapter/adapter.go`, line 52

```go
type Adapter struct {
    disc    discovery.Discoverer
    ...
}
```

The `Adapter` holds a `discovery.Discoverer` field. It calls `disc.Run` indirectly via the manager. Since `disc` is typed as `discovery.Discoverer`, any concrete type assigned to it must implement `HealthCheck`. The `Adapter` itself may want to expose a `HealthCheck` that delegates to `disc.HealthCheck(ctx)`.

---

### 2.7 `documentation/examples/custom-sd/adapter-usage/main.go` (prometheus)

**File:** `documentation/examples/custom-sd/adapter-usage/main.go`, lines 80–234

This file defines a custom `Discovery` struct that implements `Discoverer` via its `Run` method (the Consul HTTP example). It must add:

```go
func (d *Discovery) HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error {
    // e.g., ping Consul HTTP API
    resp, err := http.Get(d.address + "/v1/status/leader")
    if err != nil { return err }
    resp.Body.Close()
    return nil
}
```

---

### 2.8 `cmd/promtool/sd.go` (prometheus)

**File:** `cmd/promtool/sd.go`, lines 90–96

```go
d, err := cfg.NewDiscoverer(discovery.DiscovererOptions{...})
go func() {
    d.Run(ctx, targetGroupChan)
    ...
}()
```

`d` is typed as `discovery.Discoverer`. The `CheckSD` function could optionally call `d.HealthCheck(ctx)` before starting `Run` to pre-validate connectivity. No structural change is required here (the variable is already typed as the interface), but the function is a consumer that benefits from the new method.

---

### 2.9 `discovery/manager_test.go` (prometheus)

**File:** `discovery/manager_test.go`, lines 1494–1525

The `testDiscoverer` struct implements `Discoverer` via `Run`. It must add:

```go
func (t *testDiscoverer) HealthCheck(_ context.Context) error { return nil }
```

Similarly, `mockdiscoveryProvider` (line ~1341), `onceProvider` (line ~1423), and `lockStaticDiscoverer` (line ~1120) all implement `Discoverer` and must each add a `HealthCheck` stub.

---

### 2.10 Thanos — `cmd/thanos/endpointset.go` (thanos)

**File:** `cmd/thanos/endpointset.go`, lines 254–305

Thanos imports `github.com/prometheus/prometheus/discovery` and `github.com/prometheus/prometheus/discovery/file`. It creates a `*file.Discovery` and calls `fileSD.Run(ctx, fileSDUpdates)` directly at line 300:

```go
g.Add(func() error {
    fileSD.Run(ctx, fileSDUpdates)
    return nil
}, ...)
```

`file.Discovery` is a concrete type here, not the interface, so the call to `Run` compiles regardless. However, since `file.Discovery` must now implement `HealthCheck` to satisfy the `Discoverer` interface, Thanos gets the method for free. If Thanos ever assigns `fileSD` to a `discovery.Discoverer` variable, it will require the new method. No immediate compile break in Thanos, but the `file.Discovery` type it depends on changes.

---

### 2.11 Loki — `clients/pkg/promtail/discovery/consulagent/consul.go` (loki)

**File:** `clients/pkg/promtail/discovery/consulagent/consul.go`, lines 143–338

Loki's Promtail has its own Consul agent SD implementation with a `Discovery` struct and a `Run` method (~L307). This struct is used as a `Discoverer`. It must add `HealthCheck`:

```go
func (d *Discovery) HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error {
    // ping Consul agent health endpoint
}
```

---

### 2.12 OpenTelemetry Operator — `cmd/otel-allocator/internal/target/discovery.go` (opentelemetry-operator)

**File:** `cmd/otel-allocator/internal/target/discovery.go`, lines 33–135

The OTel allocator's `Discoverer` struct wraps a `*discovery.Manager` (the Prometheus manager). It does not directly implement the `discovery.Discoverer` interface — it has its own `Run()` method (line 126) that calls `m.manager.SyncCh()`. The `discovery.Manager` internally calls `p.d.Run()` on each provider. Since the OTel allocator uses `discovery.Manager.ApplyConfig` (line 123), all providers registered through it must implement `HealthCheck`. The allocator's own `Discoverer` struct is not typed as `discovery.Discoverer`, so no direct compile break here — but all SD configs it applies must produce `Discoverer` implementations with `HealthCheck`.

---

### 2.13 `discovery/discoverer_metrics_noop.go` (prometheus)

**File:** `discovery/discoverer_metrics_noop.go`

This implements `DiscovererMetrics` (not `Discoverer`), so no change needed. However, a parallel `NoopDiscoverer` helper that provides a default `HealthCheck() error { return nil }` would be useful for test stubs.

---

## 3. Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| **prometheus** | `discovery/discovery.go` | **Defines the `Discoverer` interface** — add `HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error` here; also contains `staticDiscoverer` which must implement it |
| **prometheus** | `discovery/refresh/refresh.go` | `Discovery` struct implements `Discoverer.Run`; shared base for ~20 providers — must add `HealthCheck` |
| **prometheus** | `discovery/manager.go` | Holds `Provider.d Discoverer`; calls `p.d.Run()` at L333; `StartCustomProvider` accepts `Discoverer` — all custom providers passed here must implement `HealthCheck` |
| **prometheus** | `discovery/manager_test.go` | `testDiscoverer`, `mockdiscoveryProvider`, `onceProvider`, `lockStaticDiscoverer` all implement `Discoverer.Run` — each must add `HealthCheck` stub |

| **prometheus** | `discovery/aws/aws.go` | Factory that creates EC2/ECS/Lightsail/MSK discoverers via `refresh.Discovery` — indirectly covered by `refresh.Discovery` fix |

SUMMARY: Adding HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error to the Discoverer interface in prometheus/discovery is a breaking change requiring all service discovery implementations to add the method. The change is centered in discovery/discovery.go and is primarily covered for ~20 providers by updating the shared discovery/refresh/refresh.go base. Custom Run implementations and external consumers like Thanos and Loki must also be updated.

FILES:
- prometheus/discovery/discovery.go — Defines the Discoverer interface and staticDiscoverer; both must implement HealthCheck
- prometheus/discovery/refresh/refresh.go — Shared base for ~20 providers; adding HealthCheck here covers them all
- prometheus/discovery/consul/consul.go — Custom Run implementation must add HealthCheck
- prometheus/discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go — Custom Run implementation must add HealthCheck
- prometheus/discovery/file/file.go — Custom Run implementation must add HealthCheck
- prometheus/discovery/zookeeper/zookeeper.go — Custom Run implementation must add HealthCheck
- prometheus/discovery/xds/xds.go — Custom Run implementation must add HealthCheck
- prometheus/discovery/manager.go — Holds Discoverer and calls Run; custom providers must implement HealthCheck
- prometheus/discovery/manager_test.go — Test Discoverer implementations must add HealthCheck stubs
- prometheus/documentation/examples/custom-sd/adapter/adapter.go — Holds Discoverer field; concrete types must implement HealthCheck
- prometheus/documentation/examples/custom-sd/adapter-usage/main.go — Custom Discoverer implementation must add HealthCheck
- prometheus/cmd/promtool/sd.go — Uses Discoverer; can benefit from HealthCheck for pre-validation
- thanos/cmd/thanos/endpointset.go — Uses file.Discovery; must implement HealthCheck to satisfy Discoverer
- loki/clients/pkg/promtail/discovery/consulagent/consul.go — Custom Discoverer implementation must add HealthCheck
- opentelemetry-operator/cmd/otel-allocator/internal/target/discovery.go — Applies SD configs; all providers must implement HealthCheck
